outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence photographs of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity shows individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars for each mouse.

The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections; individual data points are not meaningful in this heatmap context. The other elements (H&E, ICG, RNAscope images) are micrographs, not plots of averaged data.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change value per gene from DEG analysis (with corresponding p-value), not a mean of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
